## Release label

Add **one** label to this PR. It decides the next version when the PR is merged into `main`.

| Label | Version change |
| --- | --- |
| `major` | `1.2.3` → `2.0.0` |
| `minor` | `1.2.3` → `1.3.0` |
| `patch` | `1.2.3` → `1.2.4` (default when no label is set) |
| `skip-release` | Merge without tagging or publishing a release |
